prior_exposure: All F0 exposed; exact R3 fit64 reused, no fresh holdout claim. R1–R15 are closed and not replayed.
selected_question: Do fixed cross-group one-lag residual predictors generalize input innovations beyond own-past/PCA control in both component halves?
selection_budget: One fixed estimator, six ordered pairs, two complementary component partitions; no alpha/lag/PCA-size/threshold tuning.
why_decision_changing: Failing stability prevents spending on graph-masked Y predictors; passing only warrants a separate future matched mask design.
